实际在场的混合家庭与宗教团体

desc.zh: 六个月是资格、实际岗位与地方执行均连续满足后才可通过的最低观察期；若未达标，等待并补足条件，不把共享投递排队当作失败。十二个月只在选定路线确有条件缺口时提示；三十六月出现有限结算或撤回选择。十个主线事件受共享90日冷却，首个事件之后完整顺序最短约27个月。
desc.en: Six months is the minimum continuous period with eligibility, staffed posts and local execution all in place. If conditions are short, wait and address them; the shared delivery queue is not a failure. The twelve-month notice appears only for a real route-specific shortfall; month thirty-six offers limited settlement or withdrawal. The shared 90-day cooldown means the ten sequential main events take at least about 27 months after the first event.

desc.en: Run a registration pilot in one really owned state: pay a registry fee of one week of estimated yearly gross income (yearly gross income / 52, minimum 100), choose one of three routes, and only then reach survey and compensation. Execution needs real agricultural employment and a staffed office plus affordable finances; six continuous months mature the review, and any interruption restarts it from zero. Month 12 offers only a cap or renegotiation, month 36 settles or exits. Fees paid and signed compensation debts are never erased, and ordinary peace can still complete the lane.

title.en: The Service Household and the Village Each Hold a Contract

desc.zh: 同一片田上，军户拿出旧役契，村社拿出世代耕作的惯例记录。王廷要决定用哪一种凭据开册：混合仲裁让村社派人并案申诉，统一契约按现行土地法核验书面契据并由官署承接，旧权划界则保留旧界只登记无争议地段。三条路的登记费与证据要求不同，府库不足时可以先不推进。
desc.en: On the same field the service household holds an old duty contract and the village holds customary tillage records. The court must pick the evidence it will register: mixed arbitration seats villages in joint hearings, a unified contract verifies written deeds under the real land law and has the office take them up, and old-boundary delimitation keeps the old line and registers only undisputed parcels. Each route costs and demands differently, and a thin treasury may simply not advance.

desc.zh: 丈量要有人跟着走。共同资格代表随行、持契商人书面作保、或只按旧册旧界核对，三条路决定谁能签字、以及在任官署与农业就业的门槛要多高。此前的共同臣民安排在认可与岗位上越完整，可随行的代表越多；条件不够时可以缩小范围或另择一路。
desc.en: Someone must walk the line. Representatives with common eligibility may come along, contract holders may stand surety in writing, or the survey may only check the old rolls and old boundary. The three paths decide who may sign and how high the thresholds for a staffed office and agricultural employment sit. The more completely the earlier common-subjects arrangement held on acceptance and posts, the more representatives may walk along; where conditions fall short the pilot narrows or another route is taken.

desc.zh: 王廷的印与地方的印要落在同一封信上。三条真实安排互斥：王廷统筹以中央预算与在任官署承担任命，共同任命以本国真实的选举资格或共署章程为据，地方联合以地方预算份额与共同申诉为条件。选择任意一条都要另付一周估算年总收入（年总收入÷52，最低100）的文书与踏勘费，实扣成功才锁定路线。文字上选定不等于任命已经完成；失去州或政治团体变动仍可重议、限额或撤回。
desc.en: The court's seal and the locality's seal must sit on one letter. Three real arrangements are mutually exclusive: royal administration carries the appointment on a central budget and offices in post, joint appointment rests on the country's real voting qualification or a co-signed charter, and a local compact needs a local budget share and joint appeals. Any route charges a further one week of estimated yearly gross income (yearly gross income / 52, minimum 100) as the document and survey fee, and the lane locks only after the deduction really lands. Choosing the text is not completing the appointment; a lost state or a shifting political group still leaves renegotiation, capping or withdrawal open.

A lost state, war, fiscal deterioration or a shifting political group each open renegotiation, capping or withdrawal, while peace carries budget countersignature and rotating audit as usual.

cost_note.zh: 基准沿用开办时一周收入。双语公学和中央课程通常付全额，地方共办付半额；中央统筹旧章程已落实、两笔旧费已付且本试点官署和行政仍合格时，中央课程付半额。
cost_note.en: Uses the opening one-week income base. Bilingual public and central provision normally pay the full amount; joint provision pays half. Central provision pays half when the earlier central charter is established, its two fees are paid, and this pilot's offices and bureaucracy remain qualified.

consequence_note.zh: 支付本次下学期账单后进入结案审议，有限目标也须承担相应费用。
consequence_note.en: Pay this agreement's next term bill and proceed to the closing review. A limited goal also carries its applicable bill.

label.zh: 明确延期，从零重数六个月
label.en: Explicitly defer and recount six months from zero

cost_note.zh: 不重收登记费，本次暂不支付下学期账单。
cost_note.en: Registration is not charged again; the next term bill is deferred.

consequence_note.zh: 明确重开观察期，从零计算六次合格月度核查。问题仍在时，观察会再次中断。
consequence_note.en: Explicitly restart the observation period and count six satisfactory monthly checks from zero. Continuing problems interrupt the new period again.

label.zh: 等待恢复或筹齐当前账单
label.en: Wait for recovery or the current bill

cost_note.zh: 本次不收费，已付费用保留。
cost_note.en: No charge now; previous payments remain settled.

consequence_note.zh: 保留当前议题，待后续月度机会再议。
consequence_note.en: Keep the present question open for a later monthly discussion.

cost_note.en: No further charge or refund; earlier land and court accounts remain in force.

consequence_note.zh: 结束本次协议，腾出一项长期事务的办理名额。
consequence_note.en: End this agreement and free one long-term undertaking slot.

purpose.zh: 核实六个月后的真实持续支出，处理中断及现金缺口。
purpose.en: Check real continuing expenditure after six months and handle interruption or missing cash.

title.en: The Next Generation on the Roll

desc.zh: 新的登记册已经留出了下一届学生的名字。现在要决定，眼前的人员、课程和账目是否足以维持承诺：确认完整协议，接受地方共办或有限目标，承认尚未解决的缺口，或结束本次试点。
desc.en: The new roll has space for the next intake. The government must now decide whether present staff, curriculum and accounts can sustain its promise: confirm the full agreement, accept local joint provision or a limited goal, record unresolved shortcomings, or end the pilot.

cost_note.zh: 不再收费；完整供给、六次合格月度观察、两笔付款和当前试点条件均须成立。
cost_note.en: No further charge; full provision, six satisfactory monthly observations, both payments and current pilot conditions must all hold.

consequence_note.zh: 确认双语公学或中央课程协议，保留课程方向与账册，结束本次办理。
consequence_note.en: Confirm the bilingual public or central curriculum agreement, retain its direction and ledger, and conclude this undertaking.

label.zh: 确认地方共办或明确有限的协议

cost_note.zh: 不再收费；地方共办或已选有限目标须仍合格，并完成六次观察和两笔付款。
cost_note.en: No further charge; joint provision or the selected limited goal must remain qualified, with six observations and both payments complete.

consequence_note.zh: 按已经兑现的范围确认协议，保留条款、支出与前序来源。
consequence_note.en: Confirm the agreement within the scope actually delivered, retaining its terms, expenditure and earlier precedents.

label.en: Record a setback against the current gap
